payload.claim: WRITER_SHARE is specified as exactly 0.25 (the sub-cap fraction ADR 7/SA-0157 rely on to keep generation 0 within half of --budget), but no test pins that literal value. The one test that reads it (`test_a_hundred_dollar_night_writes_one_follow_up_at_the_writer_ceiling`, tests/test_follow_up.py:813-829) derives `cap_usd` from `follow_up.WRITER_SHARE` itself and only asserts a coarse outcome (1 candidate, 2 pooled) that holds for any share roughly between 0.185 and 0.37 against the real SPEC_WRITER_SESSION_USD of 18.5. Changing the constant to 0.3 leaves every test in the suite green while silently breaking the budget split the design depends on.
